bosnia2604-qualification-swap.adaptive/final:
Ms. Farrey supports EUFOR renewal and Christian Schmidt's use of executive powers. She urges Bosnia to finish the 5+2 agenda before closing the office, opposing any premature closure.

Mr. Nebenzia argues the High Representative post is vacant. He cites circumvented Council consensus and the need for Bosnian dialogue free from outside interference.
bosnia2604-qualification-swap.fixed_uk/final:
Ms. Farrey supports EUFOR renewal and backs Christian Schmidt's executive powers if needed. She opposes premature office closure, urging Bosnia to finish the 5+2 agenda before closing the office.

Mr. Nebenzia argues the High Representative post is vacant, citing circumvented Council consensus and the need for Bosnian dialogue free from outside interference.
